10.web: Now all these things happened to them by way of example, and they were written for our admonition, on whom the ends of the ages have come.
10.kjv: Now all these things happened unto them for ensamples: and they are written for our admonition, upon whom the ends of the world are come.
10.bsb: Now these things happened to them as examples and were written down as warnings for us, on whom the fulfillment of the ages has come.

10.web: Therefore let him who thinks he stands be careful that he doesn’t fall.
10.kjv: Wherefore let him that thinketh he standeth take heed lest he fall.
10.bsb: So the one who thinks he is standing firm should be careful not to fall.

10.web: No temptation has taken you except what is common to man. God is faithful, who will not allow you to be tempted above what you are able, but will with the temptation also make the way of escape, that you may be able to endure it.
10.kjv: There hath no temptation taken you but such as is common to man: but God is faithful, who will not suffer you to be tempted above that ye are able; but will with the temptation also make a way to escape, that ye may be able to bear it.
10.bsb: No temptation has seized you except what is common to man. And God is faithful; He will not let you be tempted beyond what you can bear. But when you are tempted, He will also provide an escape, so that you can stand up under it.

10.web: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.
10.kjv: Wherefore, my dearly beloved, flee from idolatry.
10.bsb: Therefore, my beloved, flee from idolatry.

10.web: I speak as to wise men. Judge what I say.
10.kjv: I speak as to wise men; judge ye what I say.
10.bsb: I speak to reasonable people; judge for yourselves what I say.

10.web: The cup of blessing which we bless, isn’t it a sharing of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, isn’t it a sharing of the body of Christ?
10.kjv: The cup of blessing which we bless, is it not the communion of the blood of Christ? The bread which we break, is it not the communion of the body of Christ?
10.bsb: Is not the cup of blessing that we bless a participation in the blood of Christ? And is not the bread that we break a participation in the body of Christ?

10.web: Because there is one loaf of bread, we, who are many, are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf of bread.
10.kjv: For we being many are one bread, and one body: for we are all partakers of that one bread.
10.bsb: Because there is one loaf, we who are many are one body; for we all partake of the one loaf.

10.web: Consider Israel according to the flesh. Don’t those who eat the sacrifices participate in the altar?
10.kjv: Behold Israel after the flesh: are not they which eat of the sacrifices partakers of the altar?
10.bsb: Consider the people of Israel: Are not those who eat the sacrifices fellow partakers in the altar?

10.web: What am I saying then? That a thing sacrificed to idols is anything, or that an idol is anything?
10.kjv: What say I then? that the idol is any thing, or that which is offered in sacrifice to idols is any thing?
10.bsb: Am I suggesting, then, that food sacrificed to an idol is anything, or that an idol is anything?

10.web: But I say that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to demons, and not to God, and I don’t desire that you would have fellowship with demons.
10.kjv: But I say , that the things which the Gentiles sacrifice, they sacrifice to devils, and not to God: and I would not that ye should have fellowship with devils.
10.bsb: No, but the sacrifices of pagans are offered to demons, not to God. And I do not want you to be participants with demons.

10.web: You can’t both drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons. You can’t both partake of the table of the Lord, and of the table of demons.
10.kjv: Ye cannot drink the cup of the Lord, and the cup of devils: ye cannot be partakers of the Lord’s table, and of the table of devils.
10.bsb: You cannot drink the cup of the Lord and the cup of demons too; you cannot partake in the table of the Lord and the table of demons too.

10.web: Or do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than he?
10.kjv: Do we provoke the Lord to jealousy? are we stronger than he?
10.bsb: Are we trying to provoke the Lord to jealousy? Are we stronger than He?

10.web: “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things are profitable. “All things are lawful for me,” but not all things build up.
10.kjv: All things are lawful for me, but all things are not expedient: all things are lawful for me, but all things edify not.
10.bsb: “Everything is permissible,” but not everything is beneficial. “Everything is permissible,” but not everything is edifying.

10.web: Let no one seek his own, but each one his neighbor’s good.
10.kjv: Let no man seek his own, but every man another’s wealth .
10.bsb: No one should seek his own good, but the good of others.

10.web: Whatever is sold in the butcher shop, eat, asking no question for the sake of conscience,
10.kjv: Whatsoever is sold in the shambles, that eat, asking no question for conscience sake:
10.bsb: Eat anything sold in the meat market without raising questions of conscience,

10.web: for “the earth is the Lord’s, and its fullness.”
10.kjv: For the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof.
10.bsb: for, “The earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness thereof.”

10.web: But if one of those who don’t believe invites you to a meal, and you are inclined to go, eat whatever is set before you, asking no questions for the sake of conscience.
10.kjv: If any of them that believe not bid you to a feast , and ye be disposed to go; whatsoever is set before you, eat, asking no question for conscience sake.
10.bsb: If an unbeliever invites you to a meal and you want to go, eat anything set before you without raising questions of conscience.

10.web: But if anyone says to you, “This was offered to idols,” don’t eat it for the sake of the one who told you, and for the sake of conscience. For “the earth is the Lord’s, and all its fullness.”
10.kjv: But if any man say unto you, This is offered in sacrifice unto idols, eat not for his sake that shewed it, and for conscience sake: for the earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof:
10.bsb: But if someone tells you, “This food was offered to idols,” then do not eat it, for the sake of the one who told you and for the sake of conscience—

10.web: Conscience, I say, not your own, but the other’s conscience. For why is my liberty judged by another conscience?
10.kjv: Conscience, I say, not thine own, but of the other: for why is my liberty judged of another man’s conscience?
10.bsb: the other one’s conscience, I mean, not your own. For why should my freedom be determined by someone else’s conscience?

10.web: If I partake with thankfulness, why am I denounced for something I give thanks for?
10.kjv: For if I by grace be a partaker, why am I evil spoken of for that for which I give thanks?
10.bsb: If I partake in the meal with thankfulness, why am I denounced because of that for which I give thanks?

10.web: Whether therefore you eat, or drink, or whatever you do, do all to the glory of God.
10.kjv: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God.
10.bsb: So whether you eat or drink or whatever you do, do it all to the glory of God.

10.web: Give no occasion for stumbling, either to Jews, or to Greeks, or to the assembly of God;
10.kjv: Give none offence, neither to the Jews, nor to the Gentiles, nor to the church of God:
10.bsb: Do not become a stumbling block, whether to Jews or Greeks or the church of God—

10.web: even as I also please all men in all things, not seeking my own profit, but the profit of the many, that they may be saved.
10.kjv: Even as I please all men in all things , not seeking mine own profit, but the profit of many, that they may be saved.
10.bsb: as I also try to please everyone in all I do. For I am not seeking my own good, but the good of many, that they may be saved.

11.web: Be imitators of me, even as I also am of Christ.
11.kjv: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
11.bsb: You are to imitate me, just as I imitate Christ.

11.web: Now I praise you, brothers, that you remember me in all things, and hold firm the traditions, even as I delivered them to you.
11.kjv: Now I praise you, brethren, that ye remember me in all things, and keep the ordinances, as I delivered them to you.
11.bsb: Now I commend you for remembering me in everything and for maintaining the traditions, just as I passed them on to you.

11.web: But I would have you know that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.
11.kjv: But I would have you know, that the head of every man is Christ; and the head of the woman is the man; and the head of Christ is God.
11.bsb: But I want you to understand that the head of every man is Christ, and the head of the woman is man, and the head of Christ is God.

11.web: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonors his head.
11.kjv: Every man praying or prophesying, having his head covered, dishonoureth his head.
11.bsb: Every man who prays or prophesies with his head covered dishonors his head.

11.web: But every woman praying or prophesying with her head uncovered dishonors her head. For it is one and the same thing as if she were shaved.
11.kjv: But every woman that prayeth or prophesieth with her head uncovered dishonoureth her head: for that is even all one as if she were shaven.
11.bsb: And every woman who prays or prophesies with her head uncovered dishonors her head, for it is just as if her head were shaved.

11.web: For if a woman is not covered, let her hair also be cut off. But if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut off or be shaved, let her be covered.
11.kjv: For if the woman be not covered, let her also be shorn: but if it be a shame for a woman to be shorn or shaven, let her be covered.
11.bsb: If a woman does not cover her head, she should have her hair cut off. And if it is shameful for a woman to have her hair cut or shaved off, she should cover her head.

11.web: For a man indeed ought not to have his head covered, because he is the image and glory of God, but the woman is the glory of the man.
11.kjv: For a man indeed ought not to cover his head, forasmuch as he is the image and glory of God: but the woman is the glory of the man.
11.bsb: A man ought not to cover his head, since he is the image and glory of God; but the woman is the glory of man.

11.web: For man is not from woman, but woman from man;
11.kjv: For the man is not of the woman; but the woman of the man.
11.bsb: For man did not come from woman, but woman from man.

11.web: for man wasn’t created for the woman, but woman for the man.
11.kjv: Neither was the man created for the woman; but the woman for the man.
11.bsb: Neither was man created for woman, but woman for man.

11.web: For this cause the woman ought to have authority over her own head, because of the angels.
11.kjv: For this cause ought the woman to have power on her head because of the angels.
11.bsb: For this reason a woman ought to have a sign of authority on her head, because of the angels.

11.web: Nevertheless, neither is the woman independent of the man, nor the man independent of the woman, in the Lord.
11.kjv: Nevertheless neither is the man without the woman, neither the woman without the man, in the Lord.
11.bsb: In the Lord, however, woman is not independent of man, nor is man independent of woman.

11.web: For as woman came from man, so a man also comes through a woman; but all things are from God.
11.kjv: For as the woman is of the man, even so is the man also by the woman; but all things of God.
11.bsb: For just as woman came from man, so also man is born of woman. But everything comes from God.

11.web: Judge for yourselves. Is it appropriate that a woman pray to God unveiled?
11.kjv: Judge in yourselves: is it comely that a woman pray unto God uncovered?
11.bsb: Judge for yourselves: Is it proper for a woman to pray to God with her head uncovered?

11.web: Doesn’t even nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a dishonor to him?
11.kjv: Doth not even nature itself teach you, that, if a man have long hair, it is a shame unto him?
11.bsb: Doesn’t nature itself teach you that if a man has long hair, it is a disgrace to him,

11.web: But if a woman has long hair, it is a glory to her, for her hair is given to her for a covering.
11.kjv: But if a woman have long hair, it is a glory to her: for her hair is given her for a covering.
11.bsb: but that if a woman has long hair, it is her glory? For long hair is given to her as a covering.

11.web: But if any man seems to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither do God’s assemblies.
11.kjv: But if any man seem to be contentious, we have no such custom, neither the churches of God.
11.bsb: If anyone is inclined to dispute this, we have no other practice, nor do the churches of God.

11.web: But in giving you this command, I don’t praise you, that you come together not for the better but for the worse.
11.kjv: Now in this that I declare unto you I praise you not, that ye come together not for the better, but for the worse.
11.bsb: In the following instructions I have no praise to offer, because your gatherings do more harm than good.

11.web: For first of all, when you come together in the assembly, I hear that divisions exist among you, and I partly believe it.
11.kjv: For first of all, when ye come together in the church, I hear that there be divisions among you; and I partly believe it.
11.bsb: First of all, I hear that when you come together as a church, there are divisions among you, and in part I believe it.

11.web: For there also must be factions among you, that those who are approved may be revealed among you.
11.kjv: For there must be also heresies among you, that they which are approved may be made manifest among you.
11.bsb: And indeed, there must be differences among you to show which of you are approved.

11.web: When therefore you assemble yourselves together, it is not the Lord’s supper that you eat.
11.kjv: When ye come together therefore into one place, this is not to eat the Lord’s supper.
11.bsb: Now then, when you come together, it is not the Lord’s Supper you eat.

11.web: For in your eating each one takes his own supper first. One is hungry, and another is drunken.
11.kjv: For in eating every one taketh before other his own supper: and one is hungry, and another is drunken.
11.bsb: For as you eat, each of you goes ahead without sharing his meal. While one remains hungry, another gets drunk.

11.web: What, don’t you have houses to eat and to drink in? Or do you despise God’s assembly, and put them to shame who don’t have enough? What shall I tell you? Shall I praise you? In this I don’t praise you.
11.kjv: What? have ye not houses to eat and to drink in? or despise ye the church of God, and shame them that have not? What shall I say to you? shall I praise you in this? I praise you not.
11.bsb: Don’t you have your own homes in which to eat and drink? Or do you despise the church of God and humiliate those who have nothing? What can I say to you? Shall I praise you for this? No, I will not!

11.web: For I received from the Lord that which also I delivered to you, that the Lord Jesus on the night in which he was betrayed took bread.
11.kjv: For I have received of the Lord that which also I delivered unto you, That the Lord Jesus the same night in which he was betrayed took bread:
11.bsb: For I received from the Lord what I also passed on to you: The Lord Jesus, on the night He was betrayed, took bread,

11.web: When he had given thanks, he broke it, and said, “Take, eat. This is my body, which is broken for you. Do this in memory of me.”
11.kjv: And when he had given thanks, he brake it , and said, Take, eat: this is my body, which is broken for you: this do in remembrance of me.
11.bsb: and when He had given thanks, He broke it and said, “This is My body, which is for you; do this in remembrance of Me.”

11.web: In the same way he also took the cup, after supper, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in my blood. Do this, as often as you drink, in memory of me.”
11.kjv: After the same manner also he took the cup, when he had supped, saying, This cup is the new testament in my blood: this do ye, as oft as ye drink it , in remembrance of me.
11.bsb: In the same way, after supper He took the cup, saying, “This cup is the new covenant in My blood; do this, as often as you drink it, in remembrance of Me.”

11.web: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until he comes.
11.kjv: For as often as ye eat this bread, and drink this cup, ye do shew the Lord’s death till he come.
11.bsb: For as often as you eat this bread and drink this cup, you proclaim the Lord’s death until He comes.

11.web: Therefore whoever eats this bread or drinks the Lord’s cup in a way unworthy of the Lord will be guilty of the body and the blood of the Lord.
11.kjv: Wherefore whosoever shall eat this bread, and drink this cup of the Lord, unworthily, shall be guilty of the body and blood of the Lord.
11.bsb: Therefore, whoever eats the bread or drinks the cup of the Lord in an unworthy manner will be guilty of sinning against the body and blood of the Lord.

11.web: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of the bread, and drink of the cup.
11.kjv: But let a man examine himself, and so let him eat of that bread, and drink of that cup.
11.bsb: Each one must examine himself before he eats of the bread and drinks of the cup.

11.web: For he who eats and drinks in an unworthy way eats and drinks judgment to himself, if he doesn’t discern the Lord’s body.
11.kjv: For he that eateth and drinketh unworthily, eateth and drinketh damnation to himself, not discerning the Lord’s body.
11.bsb: For anyone who eats and drinks without recognizing the body eats and drinks judgment on himself.

11.web: For this cause many among you are weak and sickly, and not a few sleep.
11.kjv: For this cause many are weak and sickly among you, and many sleep.
11.bsb: That is why many among you are weak and sick, and a number of you have fallen asleep.

11.web: For if we discerned ourselves, we wouldn’t be judged.
11.kjv: For if we would judge ourselves, we should not be judged.
11.bsb: Now if we judged ourselves properly, we would not come under judgment.

11.web: But when we are judged, we are punished by the Lord, that we may not be condemned with the world.
11.kjv: But when we are judged, we are chastened of the Lord, that we should not be condemned with the world.
11.bsb: But when we are judged by the Lord, we are being disciplined so that we will not be condemned with the world.

11.web: Therefore, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.
11.kjv: Wherefore, my brethren, when ye come together to eat, tarry one for another.
11.bsb: So, my brothers, when you come together to eat, wait for one another.

11.web: But if anyone is hungry, let him eat at home, lest your coming together be for judgment. The rest I will set in order whenever I come.
11.kjv: And if any man hunger, let him eat at home; that ye come not together unto condemnation. And the rest will I set in order when I come.
11.bsb: If anyone is hungry, he should eat at home, so that when you come together it will not result in judgment. And when I come, I will give instructions about the remaining matters.

12.web: Now concerning spiritual things, brothers, I don’t want you to be ignorant.
12.kjv: Now concerning spiritual gifts , brethren, I would not have you ignorant.
12.bsb: Now about spiritual gifts, brothers, I do not want you to be uninformed.

12.web: You know that when you were heathen, you were led away to those mute idols, however you might be led.
12.kjv: Ye know that ye were Gentiles, carried away unto these dumb idols, even as ye were led.
12.bsb: You know that when you were pagans, you were influenced and led astray to mute idols.

12.web: Therefore I make known to you that no man speaking by God’s Spirit says, “Jesus is accursed.” No one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” but by the Holy Spirit.
12.kjv: Wherefore I give you to understand, that no man speaking by the Spirit of God calleth Jesus accursed: and that no man can say that Jesus is the Lord, but by the Holy Ghost.
12.bsb: Therefore I inform you that no one who is speaking by the Spirit of God says, “Jesus be cursed,” and no one can say, “Jesus is Lord,” except by the Holy Spirit.

12.web: Now there are various kinds of gifts, but the same Spirit.
12.kjv: Now there are diversities of gifts, but the same Spirit.
12.bsb: There are different gifts, but the same Spirit.

12.web: There are various kinds of service, and the same Lord.
12.kjv: And there are differences of administrations, but the same Lord.
12.bsb: There are different ministries, but the same Lord.

12.web: There are various kinds of workings, but the same God, who works all things in all.
12.kjv: And there are diversities of operations, but it is the same God which worketh all in all.
12.bsb: There are different ways of working, but the same God works all things in all people.

12.web: But to each one is given the manifestation of the Spirit for the profit of all.
12.kjv: But the manifestation of the Spirit is given to every man to profit withal.
12.bsb: Now to each one the manifestation of the Spirit is given for the common good.

12.web: For to one is given through the Spirit the word of wisdom, and to another the word of knowledge, according to the same Spirit;
12.kjv: For to one is given by the Spirit the word of wisdom; to another the word of knowledge by the same Spirit;
12.bsb: To one there is given through the Spirit the message of wisdom, to another the message of knowledge by the same Spirit,

12.web: to another faith, by the same Spirit; and to another gifts of healings, by the same Spirit;
12.kjv: To another faith by the same Spirit; to another the gifts of healing by the same Spirit;
12.bsb: to another faith by the same Spirit, to another gifts of healing by that one Spirit,

12.web: and to another workings of miracles; and to another prophecy; and to another discerning of spirits; to another different kinds of languages; and to another the interpretation of languages.
12.kjv: To another the working of miracles; to another prophecy; to another discerning of spirits; to another divers kinds of tongues; to another the interpretation of tongues:
12.bsb: to another the working of miracles, to another prophecy, to another distinguishing between spirits, to another speaking in various tongues, and to still another the interpretation of tongues.

12.web: But the one and the same Spirit produces all of these, distributing to each one separately as he desires.
12.kjv: But all these worketh that one and the selfsame Spirit, dividing to every man severally as he will.
12.bsb: All these are the work of one and the same Spirit, who apportions them to each one as He determines.

12.web: For as the body is one, and has many members, and all the members of the body, being many, are one body; so also is Christ.
12.kjv: For as the body is one, and hath many members, and all the members of that one body, being many, are one body: so also is Christ.
12.bsb: The body is a unit, though it is composed of many parts. And although its parts are many, they all form one body. So it is with Christ.

12.web: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, whether bond or free; and were all given to drink into one Spirit.
12.kjv: For by one Spirit are we all baptized into one body, whether we be Jews or Gentiles, whether we be bond or free; and have been all made to drink into one Spirit.
12.bsb: For in one Spirit we were all baptized into one body, whether Jews or Greeks, slave or free, and we were all given one Spirit to drink.

12.web: For the body is not one member, but many.
12.kjv: For the body is not one member, but many.
12.bsb: For the body does not consist of one part, but of many.

12.web: If the foot would say, “Because I’m not the hand, I’m not part of the body,” it is not therefore not part of the body.
12.kjv: If the foot shall say, Because I am not the hand, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
12.bsb: If the foot should say, “Because I am not a hand, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.

12.web: If the ear would say, “Because I’m not the eye, I’m not part of the body,” it’s not therefore not part of the body.
12.kjv: And if the ear shall say, Because I am not the eye, I am not of the body; is it therefore not of the body?
12.bsb: And if the ear should say, “Because I am not an eye, I do not belong to the body,” that would not make it any less a part of the body.

12.web: If the whole body were an eye, where would the hearing be? If the whole were hearing, where would the smelling be?
12.kjv: If the whole body were an eye, where were the hearing? If the whole were hearing, where were the smelling?
12.bsb: If the whole body were an eye, where would the sense of hearing be? If the whole body were an ear, where would the sense of smell be?

12.web: But now God has set the members, each one of them, in the body, just as he desired.
12.kjv: But now hath God set the members every one of them in the body, as it hath pleased him.
12.bsb: But in fact, God has arranged the members of the body, every one of them, according to His design.

12.web: If they were all one member, where would the body be?
12.kjv: And if they were all one member, where were the body?
12.bsb: If they were all one part, where would the body be?

12.web: But now they are many members, but one body.
12.kjv: But now are they many members, yet but one body.
12.bsb: As it is, there are many parts, but one body.

12.web: The eye can’t tell the hand, “I have no need for you,” or again the head to the feet, “I have no need for you.”
12.kjv: And the eye cannot say unto the hand, I have no need of thee: nor again the head to the feet, I have no need of you.
12.bsb: The eye cannot say to the hand, “I do not need you.” Nor can the head say to the feet, “I do not need you.”

12.web: No, much rather, those members of the body which seem to be weaker are necessary.
12.kjv: Nay, much more those members of the body, which seem to be more feeble, are necessary:
12.bsb: On the contrary, the parts of the body that seem to be weaker are indispensable,

12.web: Those parts of the body which we think to be less honorable, on those we bestow more abundant honor; and our unpresentable parts have more abundant propriety;
12.kjv: And those members of the body, which we think to be less honourable, upon these we bestow more abundant honour; and our uncomely parts have more abundant comeliness.
12.bsb: and the parts we consider less honorable, we treat with greater honor. And our unpresentable parts are treated with special modesty,

12.web: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God composed the body together, giving more abundant honor to the inferior part,
12.kjv: For our comely parts have no need: but God hath tempered the body together, having given more abundant honour to that part which lacked:
12.bsb: whereas our presentable parts have no such need. But God has composed the body and has given greater honor to the parts that lacked it,

12.web: that there should be no division in the body, but that the members should have the same care for one another.
12.kjv: That there should be no schism in the body; but that the members should have the same care one for another.
12.bsb: so that there should be no division in the body, but that its members should have mutual concern for one another.

12.web: When one member suffers, all the members suffer with it. Or when one member is honored, all the members rejoice with it.
12.kjv: And whether one member suffer, all the members suffer with it; or one member be honoured, all the members rejoice with it.
12.bsb: If one part suffers, every part suffers with it; if one part is honored, every part rejoices with it.

12.web: Now you are the body of Christ, and members individually.
12.kjv: Now ye are the body of Christ, and members in particular.
12.bsb: Now you are the body of Christ, and each of you is a member of it.

12.web: God has set some in the assembly: first apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then miracle workers, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, and various kinds of languages.
12.kjv: And God hath set some in the church, first apostles, secondarily prophets, thirdly teachers, after that miracles, then gifts of healings, helps, governments, diversities of tongues.
12.bsb: And in the church God has appointed first of all apostles, second prophets, third teachers, then workers of miracles, and those with gifts of healing, helping, administration, and various tongues.

12.web: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Are all miracle workers?
12.kjv: Are all apostles? are all prophets? are all teachers? are all workers of miracles?
12.bsb: Are all apostles? Are all prophets? Are all teachers? Do all work miracles?

12.web: Do all have gifts of healings? Do all speak with various languages? Do all interpret?
12.kjv: Have all the gifts of healing? do all speak with tongues? do all interpret?
12.bsb: Do all have gifts of healing? Do all speak in tongues? Do all interpret?

12.web: But earnestly desire the best gifts. Moreover, I show a most excellent way to you.
12.kjv: But covet earnestly the best gifts: and yet shew I unto you a more excellent way.
12.bsb: But eagerly desire the greater gifts. And now I will show you the most excellent way.

13.web: If I speak with the languages of men and of angels, but don’t have love, I have become sounding brass, or a clanging cymbal.
13.kjv: Though I speak with the tongues of men and of angels, and have not charity, I am become as sounding brass, or a tinkling cymbal.
13.bsb: If I speak in the tongues of men and of angels, but have not love, I am only a ringing gong or a clanging cymbal.

13.web: If I have the gift of prophecy, and know all mysteries and all knowledge; and if I have all faith, so as to remove mountains, but don’t have love, I am nothing.
13.kjv: And though I have the gift of prophecy, and understand all mysteries, and all knowledge; and though I have all faith, so that I could remove mountains, and have not charity, I am nothing.
13.bsb: If I have the gift of prophecy and can fathom all mysteries and all knowledge, and if I have absolute faith so as to move mountains, but have not love, I am nothing.

13.web: If I give away all my goods to feed the poor, and if I give my body to be burned, but don’t have love, it profits me nothing.
13.kjv: And though I bestow all my goods to feed the poor , and though I give my body to be burned, and have not charity, it profiteth me nothing.
13.bsb: If I give all I possess to the poor and exult in the surrender of my body, but have not love, I gain nothing.

13.web: Love is patient and is kind; love doesn’t envy. Love doesn’t brag, is not proud,
13.kjv: Charity suffereth long, and is kind; charity envieth not; charity vaunteth not itself, is not puffed up,
13.bsb: Love is patient, love is kind. It does not envy, it does not boast, it is not proud.

13.web: doesn’t behave itself inappropriately, doesn’t seek its own way, is not provoked, takes no account of evil;
13.kjv: Doth not behave itself unseemly, seeketh not her own, is not easily provoked, thinketh no evil;
13.bsb: It is not rude, it is not self-seeking, it is not easily angered, it keeps no account of wrongs.

13.web: doesn’t rejoice in unrighteousness, but rejoices with the truth;
13.kjv: Rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth in the truth;
13.bsb: Love takes no pleasure in evil, but rejoices in the truth.

13.web: bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.
13.kjv: Beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
13.bsb: It bears all things, believes all things, hopes all things, endures all things.

13.web: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will be done away with. Where there are various languages, they will cease. Where there is knowledge, it will be done away with.
13.kjv: Charity never faileth: but whether there be prophecies, they shall fail; whether there be tongues, they shall cease; whether there be knowledge, it shall vanish away.
13.bsb: Love never fails. But where there are prophecies, they will cease; where there are tongues, they will be restrained; where there is knowledge, it will be dismissed.

13.web: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part;
13.kjv: For we know in part, and we prophesy in part.
13.bsb: For we know in part and we prophesy in part,

13.web: but when that which is complete has come, then that which is partial will be done away with.
13.kjv: But when that which is perfect is come, then that which is in part shall be done away.
13.bsb: but when the perfect comes, the partial passes away.

13.web: When I was a child, I spoke as a child, I felt as a child, I thought as a child. Now that I have become a man, I have put away childish things.
13.kjv: When I was a child, I spake as a child, I understood as a child, I thought as a child: but when I became a man, I put away childish things.
13.bsb: When I was a child, I talked like a child, I thought like a child, I reasoned like a child. When I became a man, I set aside childish ways.

13.web: For now we see in a mirror, dimly, but then face to face. Now I know in part, but then I will know fully, even as I was also fully known.
13.kjv: For now we see through a glass, darkly; but then face to face: now I know in part; but then shall I know even as also I am known.
13.bsb: Now we see but a dim reflection as in a mirror; then we shall see face to face. Now I know in part; then I shall know fully, even as I am fully known.

13.web: But now faith, hope, and love remain—these three. The greatest of these is love.
13.kjv: And now abideth faith, hope, charity, these three; but the greatest of these is charity.
13.bsb: And now these three remain: faith, hope, and love; but the greatest of these is love.

14.web: Follow after love, and earnestly desire spiritual gifts, but especially that you may prophesy.
14.kjv: Follow after charity, and desire spiritual gifts , but rather that ye may prophesy.
14.bsb: Earnestly pursue love and eagerly desire spiritual gifts, especially the gift of prophecy.

14.web: For he who speaks in another language speaks not to men, but to God; for no one understands; but in the Spirit he speaks mysteries.
14.kjv: For he that speaketh in an unknown tongue speaketh not unto men, but unto God: for no man understandeth him ; howbeit in the spirit he speaketh mysteries.
14.bsb: For he who speaks in a tongue does not speak to men, but to God. Indeed, no one understands him; he utters mysteries in the Spirit.

14.web: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, exhortation, and consolation.
14.kjv: But he that prophesieth speaketh unto men to edification, and exhortation, and comfort.
14.bsb: But he who prophesies speaks to men for their edification, encouragement, and comfort.

14.web: He who speaks in another language edifies himself, but he who prophesies edifies the assembly.
14.kjv: He that speaketh in an unknown tongue edifieth himself; but he that prophesieth edifieth the church.
14.bsb: The one who speaks in a tongue edifies himself, but the one who prophesies edifies the church.

14.web: Now I desire to have you all speak with other languages, but rather that you would prophesy. For he is greater who prophesies than he who speaks with other languages, unless he interprets, that the assembly may be built up.
14.kjv: I would that ye all spake with tongues, but rather that ye prophesied: for greater is he that prophesieth than he that speaketh with tongues, except he interpret, that the church may receive edifying.
14.bsb: I wish that all of you could speak in tongues, but I would rather have you prophesy. He who prophesies is greater than one who speaks in tongues, unless he interprets so that the church may be edified.

14.web: But now, brothers, if I come to you speaking with other languages, what would I profit you, unless I speak to you either by way of revelation, or of knowledge, or of prophesying, or of teaching?
14.kjv: Now, brethren, if I come unto you speaking with tongues, what shall I profit you, except I shall speak to you either by revelation, or by knowledge, or by prophesying, or by doctrine?
14.bsb: Now, brothers, if I come to you speaking in tongues, how will I benefit you, unless I bring you some revelation or knowledge or prophecy or teaching?

14.web: Even things without life, giving a voice, whether pipe or harp, if they didn’t give a distinction in the sounds, how would it be known what is piped or harped?
14.kjv: And even things without life giving sound, whether pipe or harp, except they give a distinction in the sounds, how shall it be known what is piped or harped?
14.bsb: Even in the case of lifeless instruments, such as the flute or harp, how will anyone recognize the tune they are playing unless the notes are distinct?

14.web: For if the trumpet gave an uncertain sound, who would prepare himself for war?
14.kjv: For if the trumpet give an uncertain sound, who shall prepare himself to the battle?
14.bsb: Again, if the trumpet sounds a muffled call, who will prepare for battle?

14.web: So also you, unless you uttered by the tongue words easy to understand, how would it be known what is spoken? For you would be speaking into the air.
14.kjv: So likewise ye, except ye utter by the tongue words easy to be understood, how shall it be known what is spoken? for ye shall speak into the air.
14.bsb: So it is with you. Unless you speak intelligible words with your tongue, how will anyone know what you are saying? You will just be speaking into the air.

14.web: There are, it may be, so many kinds of sounds in the world, and none of them is without meaning.
14.kjv: There are, it may be, so many kinds of voices in the world, and none of them is without signification.
14.bsb: Assuredly, there are many different languages in the world, yet none of them is without meaning.

14.web: If then I don’t know the meaning of the sound, I would be to him who speaks a foreigner, and he who speaks would be a foreigner to me.
14.kjv: Therefore if I know not the meaning of the voice, I shall be unto him that speaketh a barbarian, and he that speaketh shall be a barbarian unto me.
14.bsb: If, then, I do not know the meaning of someone’s language, I am a foreigner to the speaker, and he is a foreigner to me.

14.web: So also you, since you are zealous for spiritual gifts, seek that you may abound to the building up of the assembly.
14.kjv: Even so ye, forasmuch as ye are zealous of spiritual gifts , seek that ye may excel to the edifying of the church.
14.bsb: It is the same with you. Since you are eager to have spiritual gifts, strive to excel in gifts that build up the church.

14.web: Therefore let him who speaks in another language pray that he may interpret.
14.kjv: Wherefore let him that speaketh in an unknown tongue pray that he may interpret.
14.bsb: Therefore, the one who speaks in a tongue should pray that he may interpret.

14.web: For if I pray in another language, my spirit prays, but my understanding is unfruitful.
14.kjv: For if I pray in an unknown tongue, my spirit prayeth, but my understanding is unfruitful.
14.bsb: For if I pray in a tongue, my spirit prays, but my mind is unfruitful.

14.web: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also. I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
14.kjv: What is it then? I will pray with the spirit, and I will pray with the understanding also: I will sing with the spirit, and I will sing with the understanding also.
14.bsb: What then shall I do? I will pray with my spirit, but I will also pray with my mind. I will sing with my spirit, but I will also sing with my mind.

14.web: Otherwise if you bless with the spirit, how will he who fills the place of the unlearned say the “Amen” at your giving of thanks, seeing he doesn’t know what you say?
14.kjv: Else when thou shalt bless with the spirit, how shall he that occupieth the room of the unlearned say Amen at thy giving of thanks, seeing he understandeth not what thou sayest?
14.bsb: Otherwise, if you speak a blessing in spirit, how can someone who is uninstructed say “Amen” to your thanksgiving, since he does not know what you are saying?

14.web: For you most certainly give thanks well, but the other person is not built up.
14.kjv: For thou verily givest thanks well, but the other is not edified.
14.bsb: You may be giving thanks well enough, but the other one is not edified.

14.web: I thank my God, I speak with other languages more than you all.
14.kjv: I thank my God, I speak with tongues more than ye all:
14.bsb: I thank God that I speak in tongues more than all of you.

14.web: However in the assembly I would rather speak five words with my understanding, that I might instruct others also, than ten thousand words in another language.
14.kjv: Yet in the church I had rather speak five words with my understanding, that by my voice I might teach others also, than ten thousand words in an unknown tongue.
14.bsb: But in the church, I would rather speak five coherent words to instruct others than ten thousand words in a tongue.

14.web: Brothers, don’t be children in thoughts, yet in malice be babies, but in thoughts be mature.
14.kjv: Brethren, be not children in understanding: howbeit in malice be ye children, but in understanding be men.
14.bsb: Brothers, stop thinking like children. In regard to evil be infants, but in your thinking be mature.

14.web: In the law it is written, “By men of strange languages and by the lips of strangers I will speak to this people. Not even thus will they hear me, says the Lord.”
14.kjv: In the law it is written, With men of other tongues and other lips will I speak unto this people; and yet for all that will they not hear me, saith the Lord.
14.bsb: It is written in the Law: “By strange tongues and foreign lips I will speak to this people, but even then they will not listen to Me, says the Lord.”

14.web: Therefore other languages are for a sign, not to those who believe, but to the unbelieving; but prophesying is for a sign, not to the unbelieving, but to those who believe.
14.kjv: Wherefore tongues are for a sign, not to them that believe, but to them that believe not: but prophesying serveth not for them that believe not, but for them which believe.
14.bsb: Tongues, then, are a sign, not for believers, but for unbelievers. Prophecy, however, is for believers, not for unbelievers.

14.web: If therefore the whole assembly is assembled together and all speak with other languages, and unlearned or unbelieving people come in, won’t they say that you are crazy?
14.kjv: If therefore the whole church be come together into one place, and all speak with tongues, and there come in those that are unlearned, or unbelievers, will they not say that ye are mad?
14.bsb: So if the whole church comes together and everyone speaks in tongues, and some who are uninstructed or some unbelievers come in, will they not say that you are out of your minds?

14.web: But if all prophesy, and someone unbelieving or unlearned comes in, he is reproved by all, and he is judged by all.
14.kjv: But if all prophesy, and there come in one that believeth not, or one unlearned, he is convinced of all, he is judged of all:
14.bsb: But if an unbeliever or uninstructed person comes in while everyone is prophesying, he will be convicted and called to account by all,

14.web: And thus the secrets of his heart are revealed. So he will fall down on his face and worship God, declaring that God is among you indeed.
14.kjv: And thus are the secrets of his heart made manifest; and so falling down on his face he will worship God, and report that God is in you of a truth.
14.bsb: and the secrets of his heart will be made known. So he will fall facedown and worship God, proclaiming, “God is truly among you!”

14.web: What is it then, brothers? When you come together, each one of you has a psalm, has a teaching, has a revelation, has another language, has an interpretation. Let all things be done to build each other up.
14.kjv: How is it then, brethren? when ye come together, every one of you hath a psalm, hath a doctrine, hath a tongue, hath a revelation, hath an interpretation. Let all things be done unto edifying.
14.bsb: What then shall we say, brothers? When you come together, everyone has a psalm or a teaching, a revelation, a tongue, or an interpretation. All of these must be done to build up the church.

14.web: If any man speaks in another language, let it be two, or at the most three, and in turn; and let one interpret.
14.kjv: If any man speak in an unknown tongue, let it be by two, or at the most by three, and that by course; and let one interpret.
14.bsb: If anyone speaks in a tongue, two, or at most three, should speak in turn, and someone must interpret.

14.web: But if there is no interpreter, let him keep silent in the assembly, and let him speak to himself, and to God.
14.kjv: But if there be no interpreter, let him keep silence in the church; and let him speak to himself, and to God.
14.bsb: But if there is no interpreter, he should remain silent in the church and speak only to himself and God.

14.web: Let the prophets speak, two or three, and let the others discern.
14.kjv: Let the prophets speak two or three, and let the other judge.
14.bsb: Two or three prophets should speak, and the others should weigh carefully what is said.

14.web: But if a revelation is made to another sitting by, let the first keep silent.
14.kjv: If any thing be revealed to another that sitteth by, let the first hold his peace.
14.bsb: And if a revelation comes to someone who is seated, the first speaker should stop.

14.web: For you all can prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be exhorted.
14.kjv: For ye may all prophesy one by one, that all may learn, and all may be comforted.
14.bsb: For you can all prophesy in turn so that everyone may be instructed and encouraged.

14.web: The spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets,
14.kjv: And the spirits of the prophets are subject to the prophets.
14.bsb: The spirits of prophets are subject to prophets.

14.web: for God is not a God of confusion, but of peace, as in all the assemblies of the saints.
14.kjv: For God is not the author of confusion, but of peace, as in all churches of the saints.
14.bsb: For God is not a God of disorder, but of peace—as in all the churches of the saints.

14.web: Let the wives be quiet in the assemblies, for it has not been permitted for them to be talking except in submission, as the law also says,
14.kjv: Let your women keep silence in the churches: for it is not permitted unto them to speak; but they are commanded to be under obedience, as also saith the law.
14.bsb: Women are to be silent in the churches. They are not permitted to speak, but must be in submission, as the law says.

14.web: if they desire to learn anything. “Let them ask their own husbands at home, for it is shameful for a wife to be talking in the assembly.”
14.kjv: And if they will learn any thing, let them ask their husbands at home: for it is a shame for women to speak in the church.
14.bsb: If they wish to inquire about something, they are to ask their own husbands at home; for it is dishonorable for a woman to speak in the church.

14.web: What!? Was it from you that the word of God went out? Or did it come to you alone?
14.kjv: What? came the word of God out from you? or came it unto you only?
14.bsb: Did the word of God originate with you? Or are you the only ones it has reached?

14.web: If any man thinks himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him recognize the things which I write to you, that they are the commandment of the Lord.
14.kjv: If any man think himself to be a prophet, or spiritual, let him acknowledge that the things that I write unto you are the commandments of the Lord.
14.bsb: If anyone considers himself a prophet or spiritual person, let him acknowledge that what I am writing you is the Lord’s command.

14.web: But if anyone is ignorant, let him be ignorant.
14.kjv: But if any man be ignorant, let him be ignorant.
14.bsb: But if anyone ignores this, he himself will be ignored.

14.web: Therefore, brothers, desire earnestly to prophesy, and don’t forbid speaking with other languages.
14.kjv: Wherefore, brethren, covet to prophesy, and forbid not to speak with tongues.
14.bsb: So, my brothers, be eager to prophesy, and do not forbid speaking in tongues.

14.web: Let all things be done decently and in order.
14.kjv: Let all things be done decently and in order.
14.bsb: But everything must be done in a proper and orderly manner.

15.web: Now I declare to you, brothers, the Good News which I preached to you, which also you received, in which you also stand,
15.kjv: Moreover, brethren, I declare unto you the gospel which I preached unto you, which also ye have received, and wherein ye stand;
15.bsb: Now, brothers, I want to remind you of the gospel I preached to you, which you received, and in which you stand firm.

15.web: by which also you are saved, if you hold firmly the word which I preached to you—unless you believed in vain.
15.kjv: By which also ye are saved, if ye keep in memory what I preached unto you, unless ye have believed in vain.
15.bsb: By this gospel you are saved, if you hold firmly to the word I preached to you. Otherwise, you have believed in vain.

15.web: For I delivered to you first of all that which I also received: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,
15.kjv: For I delivered unto you first of all that which I also received, how that Christ died for our sins according to the scriptures;
15.bsb: For what I received I passed on to you as of first importance: that Christ died for our sins according to the Scriptures,

15.web: that he was buried, that he was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,
15.kjv: And that he was buried, and that he rose again the third day according to the scriptures:
15.bsb: that He was buried, that He was raised on the third day according to the Scriptures,

15.web: and that he appeared to Cephas, then to the twelve.
15.kjv: And that he was seen of Cephas, then of the twelve:
15.bsb: and that He appeared to Cephas and then to the Twelve.

15.web: Then he appeared to over five hundred brothers at once, most of whom remain until now, but some have also fallen asleep.
15.kjv: After that, he was seen of above five hundred brethren at once; of whom the greater part remain unto this present, but some are fallen asleep.
15.bsb: After that, He appeared to more than five hundred brothers at once, most of whom are still living, though some have fallen asleep.

15.web: Then he appeared to James, then to all the apostles,
15.kjv: After that, he was seen of James; then of all the apostles.
15.bsb: Then He appeared to James, then to all the apostles.

15.web: and last of all, as to the child born at the wrong time, he appeared to me also.
15.kjv: And last of all he was seen of me also, as of one born out of due time.
15.bsb: And last of all He appeared to me also, as to one of untimely birth.

15.web: For I am the least of the apostles, who is not worthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the assembly of God.
15.kjv: For I am the least of the apostles, that am not meet to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.
15.bsb: For I am the least of the apostles and am unworthy to be called an apostle, because I persecuted the church of God.

15.web: But by the grace of God I am what I am. His grace which was given to me was not futile, but I worked more than all of them; yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
15.kjv: But by the grace of God I am what I am: and his grace which was bestowed upon me was not in vain; but I laboured more abundantly than they all: yet not I, but the grace of God which was with me.
15.bsb: But by the grace of God I am what I am, and His grace to me was not in vain. No, I worked harder than all of them—yet not I, but the grace of God that was with me.

15.web: Whether then it is I or they, so we preach, and so you believed.
15.kjv: Therefore whether it were I or they, so we preach, and so ye believed.
15.bsb: Whether, then, it was I or they, this is what we preach, and this is what you believed.

15.web: Now if Christ is preached, that he has been raised from the dead, how do some among you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?
15.kjv: Now if Christ be preached that he rose from the dead, how say some among you that there is no resurrection of the dead?
15.bsb: But if it is preached that Christ has been raised from the dead, how can some of you say that there is no resurrection of the dead?

15.web: But if there is no resurrection of the dead, neither has Christ been raised.
15.kjv: But if there be no resurrection of the dead, then is Christ not risen:
15.bsb: If there is no resurrection of the dead, then not even Christ has been raised.

15.web: If Christ has not been raised, then our preaching is in vain, and your faith also is in vain.
15.kjv: And if Christ be not risen, then is our preaching vain, and your faith is also vain.
15.bsb: And if Christ has not been raised, our preaching is worthless, and so is your faith.

15.web: Yes, we are also found false witnesses of God, because we testified about God that he raised up Christ, whom he didn’t raise up, if it is so that the dead are not raised.
15.kjv: Yea, and we are found false witnesses of God; because we have testified of God that he raised up Christ: whom he raised not up, if so be that the dead rise not.
15.bsb: In that case, we are also exposed as false witnesses about God. For we have testified about God that He raised Christ from the dead, but He did not raise Him if in fact the dead are not raised.

15.web: For if the dead aren’t raised, neither has Christ been raised.
15.kjv: For if the dead rise not, then is not Christ raised:
15.bsb: For if the dead are not raised, then not even Christ has been raised.

15.web: If Christ has not been raised, your faith is vain; you are still in your sins.
15.kjv: And if Christ be not raised, your faith is vain; ye are yet in your sins.
15.bsb: And if Christ has not been raised, your faith is futile; you are still in your sins.

15.web: Then they also who are fallen asleep in Christ have perished.
15.kjv: Then they also which are fallen asleep in Christ are perished.
15.bsb: Then those also who have fallen asleep in Christ have perished.

15.web: If we have only hoped in Christ in this life, we are of all men most pitiable.
15.kjv: If in this life only we have hope in Christ, we are of all men most miserable.
15.bsb: If our hope in Christ is for this life alone, we are to be pitied more than all men.

15.web: But now Christ has been raised from the dead. He became the first fruits of those who are asleep.
15.kjv: But now is Christ risen from the dead, and become the firstfruits of them that slept.
15.bsb: But Christ has indeed been raised from the dead, the firstfruits of those who have fallen asleep.

15.web: For since death came by man, the resurrection of the dead also came by man.
15.kjv: For since by man came death, by man came also the resurrection of the dead.
15.bsb: For since death came through a man, the resurrection of the dead comes also through a man.

15.web: For as in Adam all die, so also in Christ all will be made alive.
15.kjv: For as in Adam all die, even so in Christ shall all be made alive.
15.bsb: For as in Adam all die, so in Christ all will be made alive.

15.web: But each in his own order: Christ the first fruits, then those who are Christ’s, at his coming.
15.kjv: But every man in his own order: Christ the firstfruits; afterward they that are Christ’s at his coming.
15.bsb: But each in his own turn: Christ the firstfruits; then at His coming, those who belong to Him.

15.web: Then the end comes, when he will deliver up the Kingdom to God, even the Father; when he will have abolished all rule and all authority and power.
15.kjv: Then cometh the end, when he shall have delivered up the kingdom to God, even the Father; when he shall have put down all rule and all authority and power.
15.bsb: Then the end will come, when He hands over the kingdom to God the Father after He has destroyed all dominion, authority, and power.

15.web: For he must reign until he has put all his enemies under his feet.
15.kjv: For he must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.
15.bsb: For He must reign until He has put all His enemies under His feet.

15.web: The last enemy that will be abolished is death.
15.kjv: The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death.
15.bsb: The last enemy to be destroyed is death.

15.web: For, “He put all things in subjection under his feet.” But when he says, “All things are put in subjection”, it is evident that he is excepted who subjected all things to him.
15.kjv: For he hath put all things under his feet. But when he saith all things are put under him, it is manifest that he is excepted, which did put all things under him.
15.bsb: For “God has put everything under His feet.” Now when it says that everything has been put under Him, this clearly does not include the One who put everything under Him.

15.web: When all things have been subjected to him, then the Son will also himself be subjected to him who subjected all things to him, that God may be all in all.
15.kjv: And when all things shall be subdued unto him, then shall the Son also himself be subject unto him that put all things under him, that God may be all in all.
15.bsb: And when all things have been subjected to Him, then the Son Himself will be made subject to Him who put all things under Him, so that God may be all in all.

15.web: Or else what will they do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead aren’t raised at all, why then are they baptized for the dead?
15.kjv: Else what shall they do which are baptized for the dead, if the dead rise not at all? why are they then baptized for the dead?
15.bsb: If these things are not so, what will those do who are baptized for the dead? If the dead are not raised at all, why are people baptized for them?

15.web: Why do we also stand in jeopardy every hour?
15.kjv: And why stand we in jeopardy every hour?
15.bsb: And why do we endanger ourselves every hour?

15.web: I affirm, by the boasting in you which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
15.kjv: I protest by your rejoicing which I have in Christ Jesus our Lord, I die daily.
15.bsb: I face death every day, brothers, as surely as I boast about you in Christ Jesus our Lord.

15.web: If I fought with animals at Ephesus for human purposes, what does it profit me? If the dead are not raised, then “let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”
15.kjv: If after the manner of men I have fought with beasts at Ephesus, what advantageth it me, if the dead rise not? let us eat and drink; for to morrow we die.
15.bsb: If I fought wild beasts in Ephesus for human motives, what did I gain? If the dead are not raised, “Let us eat and drink, for tomorrow we die.”

15.web: Don’t be deceived! “Evil companionships corrupt good morals.”
15.kjv: Be not deceived: evil communications corrupt good manners.
15.bsb: Do not be deceived: “Bad company corrupts good character.”

15.web: Wake up righteously, and don’t sin, for some have no knowledge of God. I say this to your shame.
15.kjv: Awake to righteousness, and sin not; for some have not the knowledge of God: I speak this to your shame.
15.bsb: Sober up as you ought, and stop sinning; for some of you are ignorant of God. I say this to your shame.

15.web: But someone will say, “How are the dead raised?” and, “With what kind of body do they come?”
15.kjv: But some man will say, How are the dead raised up? and with what body do they come?
15.bsb: But someone will ask, “How are the dead raised? With what kind of body will they come?”

15.web: You foolish one, that which you yourself sow is not made alive unless it dies.
15.kjv: Thou fool, that which thou sowest is not quickened, except it die:
15.bsb: You fool! What you sow does not come to life unless it dies.

15.web: That which you sow, you don’t sow the body that will be, but a bare grain, maybe of wheat, or of some other kind.
15.kjv: And that which thou sowest, thou sowest not that body that shall be, but bare grain, it may chance of wheat, or of some other grain :
15.bsb: And what you sow is not the body that will be, but just a seed, perhaps of wheat or something else.

15.web: But God gives it a body even as it pleased him, and to each seed a body of its own.
15.kjv: But God giveth it a body as it hath pleased him, and to every seed his own body.
15.bsb: But God gives it a body as He has designed, and to each kind of seed He gives its own body.

15.web: All flesh is not the same flesh, but there is one flesh of men, another flesh of animals, another of fish, and another of birds.
15.kjv: All flesh is not the same flesh: but there is one kind of flesh of men, another flesh of beasts, another of fishes, and another of birds.
15.bsb: Not all flesh is the same: Men have one kind of flesh, animals have another, birds another, and fish another.

15.web: There are also celestial bodies, and terrestrial bodies; but the glory of the celestial differs from that of the terrestrial.
15.kjv: There are also celestial bodies, and bodies terrestrial: but the glory of the celestial is one, and the glory of the terrestrial is another.
15.bsb: There are also heavenly bodies and earthly bodies. But the splendor of the heavenly bodies is of one degree, and the splendor of the earthly bodies is of another.

15.web: There is one glory of the sun, another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars; for one star differs from another star in glory.
15.kjv: There is one glory of the sun, and another glory of the moon, and another glory of the stars: for one star differeth from another star in glory.
15.bsb: The sun has one degree of splendor, the moon another, and the stars another; and star differs from star in splendor.

15.web: So also is the resurrection of the dead. The body is sown perishable; it is raised imperishable.
15.kjv: So also is the resurrection of the dead. It is sown in corruption; it is raised in incorruption:
15.bsb: So will it be with the resurrection of the dead: What is sown is perishable; it is raised imperishable.

15.web: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.
15.kjv: It is sown in dishonour; it is raised in glory: it is sown in weakness; it is raised in power:
15.bsb: It is sown in dishonor; it is raised in glory. It is sown in weakness; it is raised in power.

15.web: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body and there is also a spiritual body.
15.kjv: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. There is a natural body, and there is a spiritual body.
15.bsb: It is sown a natural body; it is raised a spiritual body. If there is a natural body, there is also a spiritual body.

15.web: So also it is written, “The first man, Adam, became a living soul.” The last Adam became a life-giving spirit.
15.kjv: And so it is written, The first man Adam was made a living soul; the last Adam was made a quickening spirit.
15.bsb: So it is written: “The first man Adam became a living being;” the last Adam a life-giving spirit.

15.web: However that which is spiritual isn’t first, but that which is natural, then that which is spiritual.
15.kjv: Howbeit that was not first which is spiritual, but that which is natural; and afterward that which is spiritual.
15.bsb: The spiritual, however, was not first, but the natural, and then the spiritual.

15.web: The first man is of the earth, made of dust. The second man is the Lord from heaven.
15.kjv: The first man is of the earth, earthy: the second man is the Lord from heaven.
15.bsb: The first man was of the dust of the earth, the second man from heaven.

15.web: As is the one made of dust, such are those who are also made of dust; and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
15.kjv: As is the earthy, such are they also that are earthy: and as is the heavenly, such are they also that are heavenly.
15.bsb: As was the earthly man, so also are those who are of the earth; and as is the heavenly man, so also are those who are of heaven.

15.web: As we have borne the image of those made of dust, let’s also bear the image of the heavenly.
15.kjv: And as we have borne the image of the earthy, we shall also bear the image of the heavenly.
15.bsb: And just as we have borne the likeness of the earthly man, so also shall we bear the likeness of the heavenly man.

15.web: Now I say this, brothers, that flesh and blood can’t inherit God’s Kingdom; neither does the perishable inherit imperishable.
15.kjv: Now this I say, brethren, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God; neither doth corruption inherit incorruption.
15.bsb: Now I declare to you, brothers, that flesh and blood cannot inherit the kingdom of God, nor does the perishable inherit the imperishable.

15.web: Behold, I tell you a mystery. We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed,
15.kjv: Behold, I shew you a mystery; We shall not all sleep, but we shall all be changed,
15.bsb: Listen, I tell you a mystery: We will not all sleep, but we will all be changed—

15.web: in a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, and the dead will be raised incorruptible, and we will be changed.
15.kjv: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump: for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
15.bsb: in an instant, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trumpet. For the trumpet will sound, the dead will be raised imperishable, and we will be changed.

15.web: For this perishable body must become imperishable, and this mortal must put on immortality.
15.kjv: For this corruptible must put on incorruption, and this mortal must put on immortality.
15.bsb: For the perishable must be clothed with the imperishable, and the mortal with immortality.

15.web: But when this perishable body will have become imperishable, and this mortal will have put on immortality, then what is written will happen: “Death is swallowed up in victory.”
15.kjv: So when this corruptible shall have put on incorruption, and this mortal shall have put on immortality, then shall be brought to pass the saying that is written, Death is swallowed up in victory.
15.bsb: When the perishable has been clothed with the imperishable and the mortal with immortality, then the saying that is written will come to pass: “Death has been swallowed up in victory.”

15.web: “Death, where is your sting? Hades, where is your victory?”
15.kjv: O death, where is thy sting? O grave, where is thy victory?
15.bsb: “Where, O Death, is your victory? Where, O Death, is your sting?”

15.web: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.
15.kjv: The sting of death is sin; and the strength of sin is the law.
15.bsb: The sting of death is sin, and the power of sin is the law.

15.web: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
15.kjv: But thanks be to God, which giveth us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ.
15.bsb: But thanks be to God, who gives us the victory through our Lord Jesus Christ!

15.web: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast, immovable, always abounding in the Lord’s work, because you know that your labor is not in vain in the Lord.
15.kjv: Therefore, my beloved brethren, be ye stedfast, unmoveable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, forasmuch as ye know that your labour is not in vain in the Lord.
15.bsb: Therefore, my beloved brothers, be steadfast and immovable. Always excel in the work of the Lord, because you know that your labor in the Lord is not in vain.

16.web: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I commanded the assemblies of Galatia, you do likewise.
16.kjv: Now concerning the collection for the saints, as I have given order to the churches of Galatia, even so do ye.
16.bsb: Now about the collection for the saints, you are to do as I directed the churches of Galatia:

16.web: On the first day of the week, let each one of you save, as he may prosper, that no collections be made when I come.
16.kjv: Upon the first day of the week let every one of you lay by him in store, as God hath prospered him, that there be no gatherings when I come.
16.bsb: On the first day of every week, each of you should set aside a portion of his income, saving it up, so that when I come no collections will be needed.

16.web: When I arrive, I will send whoever you approve with letters to carry your gracious gift to Jerusalem.
16.kjv: And when I come, whomsoever ye shall approve by your letters, them will I send to bring your liberality unto Jerusalem.
16.bsb: Then, on my arrival, I will send letters with those you recommend to carry your gift to Jerusalem.

16.web: If it is appropriate for me to go also, they will go with me.
16.kjv: And if it be meet that I go also, they shall go with me.
16.bsb: And if it is advisable for me to go also, they can travel with me.

16.web: But I will come to you when I have passed through Macedonia, for I am passing through Macedonia.
16.kjv: Now I will come unto you, when I shall pass through Macedonia: for I do pass through Macedonia.
16.bsb: After I go through Macedonia, however, I will come to you; for I will be going through Macedonia.

16.web: But with you it may be that I will stay, or even winter, that you may send me on my journey wherever I go.
16.kjv: And it may be that I will abide, yea, and winter with you, that ye may bring me on my journey whithersoever I go.
16.bsb: Perhaps I will stay with you awhile, or even spend the winter, so that you can help me on my journey, wherever I go.

16.web: For I do not wish to see you now in passing, but I hope to stay a while with you, if the Lord permits.
16.kjv: For I will not see you now by the way; but I trust to tarry a while with you, if the Lord permit.
16.bsb: For I do not want to see you now only in passing; I hope to spend some time with you, if the Lord permits.

16.web: But I will stay at Ephesus until Pentecost,
16.kjv: But I will tarry at Ephesus until Pentecost.
16.bsb: But I will stay in Ephesus until Pentecost,

16.web: for a great and effective door has opened to me, and there are many adversaries.
16.kjv: For a great door and effectual is opened unto me, and there are many adversaries.
16.bsb: because a great door for effective work has opened to me, even though many oppose me.

16.web: Now if Timothy comes, see that he is with you without fear, for he does the work of the Lord, as I also do.
16.kjv: Now if Timotheus come, see that he may be with you without fear: for he worketh the work of the Lord, as I also do .
16.bsb: If Timothy comes, see to it that he has nothing to fear while he is with you, for he is doing the work of the Lord, just as I am.

16.web: Therefore let no one despise him. But set him forward on his journey in peace, that he may come to me; for I expect him with the brothers.
16.kjv: Let no man therefore despise him: but conduct him forth in peace, that he may come unto me: for I look for him with the brethren.
16.bsb: No one, then, should treat him with contempt. Send him on his way in peace so that he can return to me, for I am expecting him along with the brothers.

16.web: Now concerning Apollos, the brother, I strongly urged him to come to you with the brothers; and it was not at all his desire to come now; but he will come when he has an opportunity.
16.kjv: As touching our brother Apollos, I greatly desired him to come unto you with the brethren: but his will was not at all to come at this time; but he will come when he shall have convenient time.
16.bsb: Now about our brother Apollos: I strongly urged him to go to you with the brothers. He was not at all inclined to go now, but he will go when he has the opportunity.

16.web: Watch! Stand firm in the faith! Be courageous! Be strong!
16.kjv: Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.
16.bsb: Be on the alert. Stand firm in the faith. Be men of courage. Be strong.

16.web: Let all that you do be done in love.
16.kjv: Let all your things be done with charity.
16.bsb: Do everything in love.

16.web: Now I beg you, brothers (you know the house of Stephanas, that it is the first fruits of Achaia, and that they have set themselves to serve the saints),
16.kjv: I beseech you, brethren, (ye know the house of Stephanas, that it is the firstfruits of Achaia, and that they have addicted themselves to the ministry of the saints,)
16.bsb: You know that Stephanas and his household were the first converts in Achaia, and they have devoted themselves to the service of the saints. Now I urge you, brothers,

16.web: that you also be in subjection to such, and to everyone who helps in the work and labors.
16.kjv: That ye submit yourselves unto such, and to every one that helpeth with us , and laboureth.
16.bsb: to submit to such as these, and to every fellow worker and laborer.

16.web: I rejoice at the coming of Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus; for that which was lacking on your part, they supplied.
16.kjv: I am glad of the coming of Stephanas and Fortunatus and Achaicus: for that which was lacking on your part they have supplied.
16.bsb: I am glad that Stephanas, Fortunatus, and Achaicus have arrived, because they have supplied what was lacking from you.

16.web: For they refreshed my spirit and yours. Therefore acknowledge those who are like that.
16.kjv: For they have refreshed my spirit and yours: therefore acknowledge ye them that are such.
16.bsb: For they refreshed my spirit and yours as well. Show your appreciation, therefore, to such men.

16.web: The assemblies of Asia greet you. Aquila and Priscilla greet you much in the Lord, together with the assembly that is in their house.
16.kjv: The churches of Asia salute you. Aquila and Priscilla salute you much in the Lord, with the church that is in their house.
16.bsb: The churches in the province of Asia send you greetings. Aquila and Prisca greet you warmly in the Lord, and so does the church that meets at their house.

16.web: All the brothers greet you. Greet one another with a holy kiss.
16.kjv: All the brethren greet you. Greet ye one another with an holy kiss.
16.bsb: All the brothers here send you greetings. Greet one another with a holy kiss.

16.web: This greeting is by me, Paul, with my own hand.
16.kjv: The salutation of me Paul with mine own hand.
16.bsb: This greeting is in my own hand—Paul.

16.web: If any man doesn’t love the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be accursed. Come, Lord!
16.kjv: If any man love not the Lord Jesus Christ, let him be Anathema Maranatha.
16.bsb: If anyone does not love the Lord, let him be under a curse. Come, O Lord!

16.web: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
16.kjv: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
16.bsb: The grace of the Lord Jesus be with you.

16.web: My love to all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
16.kjv: My love be with you all in Christ Jesus. Amen.
16.bsb: My love be with all of you in Christ Jesus. Amen.
